gen-fs-telma-instrument-sans: Quiet pen-written grace: Telma flows along a high mean line. Instrument Sans, a sans-serif with uniform stroke weight, gives it a firm footing, though it isn't built for dense, lengthy paragraphs.
gen-gf-amita-plus-jakarta-sans: Amita looks hand-drawn, with rounded, open letters that feel relaxed and friendly. Plus Jakarta Sans is the precise one, a monoline sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart, leaving Amita to supply the charm.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-fs-amulya: Relaxed and graceful, Architects Daughter writes s curves that swing open at both ends and diagonals that echo its stems. Amulya, a sans-serif with generous curve gaps, adds a modern counterweight, and the pair is pleasant in brief bites.
gen-gf-architects-daughter-outfit: Architects Daughter looks sketched by hand, its s curves swinging open at both ends and its diagonals echoing the stems. Outfit keeps things tidy with cable-like strokes, made for quick glances.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-stint-ultra-expande: Loud and rounded, Autour One draws bold letters with a clear lead-in to each curve and no hairline shifts. Stint Ultra Expanded sits beneath, its serif letters floating apart, traditional and authoritative.
gen-gf-bahiana-fs-rowan: Chunky and rod-stiff, like words cut from stock. Bahiana packs words into solid blocks for brief headlines, while literary Rowan, with generous curves and moderate contrast, keeps quick reading friendly.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaijaan-2-fs-karma: Baloo Bhaijaan 2 fills a deep central band of the line with open, generous curves. Karma, with gentle stroke shifts and barely any step down to its lowercase, is the trustworthy anchor.
gen-gf-baloo-da-2-fs-karma: Karma reads with a trustworthy hand, weight shifts present but never dramatic. Karma keeps pages of text going down smoothly, while Baloo Da 2 brings wide-set s terminals and lowercase nearly at cap height.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-karma: Big, open shapes with real presence, right up top. Baloo Tamma 2 opens generous counters in its lowercase, while Karma's small, gentle weight steps carry paragraphs along without a single snag.
gen-gf-baloo-tamma-2-fs-paquito: Baloo Tamma 2 opens big counters in its lowercase. Paquito, confident and approachable, with barely any step from lowercase to caps, is a good fit for brief bursts, and would wear on you over pages.
